title: 第5章 外门弟子第6章 炼药堂
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
林潜继续修炼起了通臂拳。
单晃掌、撩阴掌、双盖掌、平拳，尖拳，斩首拳......
一式式通臂拳的招式，林潜练的极为流畅、熟练，动作赏心悦目，行云流水。
随着进入状态，林潜感受到身体微微发热，额头、后背逐渐有汗水渗出，这是表明锻炼的效果极佳。
擦了擦汗水，林潜调出熟练度面板。
姓名：林潜
寿命：1460岁
武技：通臂拳（二阶1.5%）。
“加了0.3%熟练度，还可以。”
林潜微微点头，这一个月他发现每次修炼通臂拳，增加的熟练度不是固定的，有时候会加的多一点，有时候会加得少一点。
看了天色，不早了，林潜简单洗漱后，开始了一天的工作。
......
夜幕帷幕，星光黯淡。
演武场上还有人在修炼武技，这刻苦的精神让林潜忍不住偷偷给他们点个赞。
林潜悄咪咪的来到演武场一角，先装模作样打了一套通臂拳。
然后来到放石锁的地方，找到两百斤的石锁。
双腿下蹲，双手握住石锁把手，双手用力向上提，只见石锁随着他的身体慢慢上升，直至他完全站立身体。
林潜咬紧牙关，面目通红，手臂上凸起的青筋显示着他并不轻松。
几秒钟后，林潜轻轻放下了石锁，大口喘气，脸上露出了笑容。
“外门弟子稳了啊。”

虽然有些吃力，但终归是提起了这两百斤的石锁。
只需要等一个月后就能成为外门弟子。
在原地休息了片刻，林潜慢悠悠的朝着房间走去。
“现在勉强能提起两百斤，还有一个月时间修炼，力量肯定还会增加。”
林潜面露期待。
突破到练皮，林潜力量大增，工作起来更加得心应手。
要不是许阳做得慢了些，他能提前两个小时做完，现在林潜干活都不怎么喘气了。
林潜的变化让许阳大为惊奇，但是他没往林潜能突破练皮方面想，在许阳看来是不可能的。
因为林潜跟着张执事练了一周后，就再也没有去演武场了。
虽然看见林潜一个人在院子里修炼，但在许阳看来，一个人练这不是闭门造车嘛，说不定还练出问题来。
刚开始许阳还会叫林潜一起去演武场，林潜都拒绝了，后面许阳就没再叫林潜去演武场了。
许阳认定林潜已经放弃了修炼武技。
其实林潜主要是觉得演武场人多眼杂，说不定还容易起冲突，并且他有熟练度面板，没必要向别人请教，就没去练武场，直接是在院子里修炼岂不是更方便。
因为许阳和林潜是住在同一个房间，两人每天分配的任务基本上都是一样的。
今天两人的任务是挑水，需要把五个大水缸挑满才算完成任务。
每个人差不多要跑二十多趟才能完成注满水缸。
“潜哥，我们这一批已经有好几个人突破到练皮了。”
许阳挑着水看着走在前面的林潜说道。
content_en:
Lin Qian continued to practice the through-arm boxing.
Single shaking palm, teasing palm, double cover palm, flat fist, sharp fist, decapitation fist...
Lin Qian practiced the one-style through-arm boxing move extremely smoothly and skillfully, and the movements were pleasing to the eye and flowed smoothly.
As he entered the state, Lin Qian felt his body heat up slightly, and sweat gradually oozed from his forehead and back, which showed that the effect of the exercise was excellent.
Lin Qian wiped his sweat and brought up the proficiency panel.
Name: Lin Qian
Lifespan: 1460 years
Martial skill: Arm-Through Fist (second level 1.5%).
"Added 0.3% proficiency, it's not bad."
Lin Qian nodded slightly. This month, he found that every time he practiced Tongjiquan, the increased proficiency was not fixed. Sometimes it would be more, and sometimes it would be less.
After looking at the sky, it was getting late. After Lin Qian simply washed up, he started his day's work.
...
The night has fallen and the stars have dimmed.
There were people practicing martial arts in the martial arts arena, and Lin Qian couldn't help but secretly give them a thumbs up for their hard work.
Lin Qian quietly came to a corner of the martial arts arena and pretended to do a set of through-arm punches.
Then he came to the place where the stone locks were placed and found a two hundred kilogram stone lock.
He squatted down with his legs, held the handle of the stone lock with both hands, and lifted it up with both hands. The stone lock slowly rose with his body until he stood completely.
Lin Qian gritted his teeth, his face flushed, and the raised veins on his arms showed that he was not relaxed.
After a few seconds, Lin Qian gently put down the stone lock, gasped for air, and smiled on his face.
"The outer disciples are safe."
Although it was a bit difficult, I finally managed to lift the two hundred kilograms of stone locks.
You only need to wait a month to become an outer disciple.
After resting on the spot for a moment, Lin Qian slowly walked towards the room.
"Now I can barely lift two hundred kilograms. I still have a month to practice, and my strength will definitely increase."
Lin Qian looked expectant.
After breaking through to skin training, Lin's potential power is greatly increased and he becomes more comfortable at work.
If Xu Yang hadn't done it a little slowly, he could have finished it two hours earlier. Now Lin Qian doesn't even have to breathe much while working.
Xu Yang was greatly surprised by Lin Qian's changes, but he didn't think about Lin Qian's breakthrough in skin training, which seemed impossible to Xu Yang.
Because after Lin Qian practiced with Deacon Zhang for a week, he never went to the martial arts field again.
Although he saw Lin Qian practicing alone in the yard, in Xu Yang's opinion, practicing alone was not a practice behind closed doors, and might even cause problems.
At first, Xu Yang would ask Lin Qian to go to the martial arts arena with him, but Lin Qian refused. Later, Xu Yang never asked Lin Qian to go to the martial arts arena again.
Xu Yang believed that Lin Qian had given up on practicing martial arts.
In fact, Lin Qian mainly felt that there were too many people in the martial arts field, which might lead to conflicts, and since he had a proficiency panel, he didn't need to ask others for advice, so he didn't go to the martial arts field. Wouldn't it be more convenient to practice directly in the yard.
Because Xu Yang and Lin Qian live in the same room, the tasks assigned to them every day are basically the same.
The task for the two of them today is to carry water. They need to fill five large water tanks to complete the task.
Each person has to make almost twenty trips to fill the water tank.
"Brother Qian, several of our batch have already broken through to skin training."
Xu Yang held the water and looked at Lin Qian walking in front and said.
